name: avoid_infinite_recursion_with_inferrever_fd238857
subject: Avoid infinite recursion with `inferReverseMappedType` (#57837)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Fixes infinite recursion in inferReverseMappedType for recursive homomorphic mapped type inference by replacing the old string-keyed stack with source/target stacks, expanding-flags tracking, and undefined-propagation. The recursion would otherwise overflow the stack.
